title: Log remote user URIs that lack /u/ (decision mimid-1wgh.6.80)
description: Mark 2026-11-16: accept remote user URIs without the protocol-07 §2.1 /u/ form, and log the divergence (lenient on received meaning, mimid-1wgh.52 rule 3). Sites: follower/consent.rs (remote URI), hub/key_material.rs:107,134, hub/update.rs:421,461,672-673. At each, keep the domain check; when the path is not /u/<name>, emit one DEBUG event (bounded: a per-process set of seen (domain, path-shape) so a peer cannot flood the log; or a metric) naming the URI's domain. In hub/update.rs exclude the hub's own provider URI mimi://<domain> (decision .6.35). Local users keep the refusal (.6.76/.6.79).
close_reason: d1569ae: note_non_user_uri at keyMaterial, consent and proposal-sender sites; once per domain, capped at 256.
